subject: FedRAMP & ISO readiness — evidence routing, log snapshots and dry-run capacity
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@bluefinbank.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming audit window & evidence questions

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. BlueFin is finalizing our vendor audit window for late August and we have a couple of questions that will shape our evidence intake: 

1) Log retention snapshots: our auditors want a 90-day contiguous log sample but also a point-in-time snapshot for incidents. Can you confirm your standard snapshot cadence and whether we can request an ad-hoc snapshot tied to an auditor run?

2) Sampling / evidence volume: for SIG/CAIQ + SOC2 we expect ~120 discrete artifacts plus a sampling of application logs and access reviews. Do you have capacity limits on on-demand evidence pulls that we should plan for?

3) Redlines & contract clause: we may need a short carve-out around retention windows in our contract. Who from your side coordinates legal/contract escalation?

I've attached our intake checklist so you can see the exact asks. We'd like a 30-minute dry run in July to validate access and artifact locations. What dates work for you?

Appreciate it —
Maria Lopez
Head of Vendor Risk | BlueFin Bank

Attachment: BlueFin_Audit_Checklist.xlsx

From: markus_klein@redwood-inference.com
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@bluefinbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming audit window & evidence questions

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the checklist — this is helpful. High-level answers and proposed plan below: 

- Snapshot cadence: We maintain rolling logs for 180 days by default and can produce point-in-time snapshots (AWS S3 + encrypted archive) on request. For an auditor run we can create a snapshot within 48 hours; ad-hoc snapshots are supported but require a short intake (owner + justification) so we can lock the window.

- Evidence pull capacity: Our evidence intake pipeline is centralized through the Compliance Playbook (linked below). For a typical audit we can support up to ~200 artifact requests in parallel; heavy log extraction (>500GB) will need scheduling into a maintenance window. For your expected ~120 artifacts + sampled logs we are within normal bounds.

- Legal / contract liaison: Please loop in kimberly_park (CC'd) for any retention clause discussions. She handles contractual carve-outs and will coordinate with Legal.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule the 30-minute dry run week of July 20 — we can do Tue/Wed mornings (PDT).
2) BlueFin to confirm which artifacts require point-in-time snapshots vs. links to long-term archives.
3) We run a small dry-run extraction (non-prod) to validate access and format; that will surface any script changes.

I'll also add david_kim from infra to the thread to cover log extraction logistics.

Links:
- Compliance playbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cCompliancePlaybooks
- Intake record (HubSpot): HS-23456

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com
To: markus_klein@redwood-inference.com, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@bluefinbank.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com, david_kim@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming audit window & evidence questions

On Wed, Jul 1, 2026 at 09:18 AM markus_klein@redwood-inference.com wrote:
> - Snapshot cadence: We maintain rolling logs for 180 days by default and can produce point-in-time snapshots (AWS S3 + encrypted archive) on request. For an auditor run we can create a snapshot within 48 hours; ad-hoc snapshots are supported but require a short intake (owner + justification) so we can lock the window.

A couple of clarifications from Legal/Compliance perspective: 

- Snapshot retention vs. export retention: we will create the snapshot and retain the exported archive for 30 days by default unless BlueFin requests longer. If you need the archive preserved beyond audit close, we can negotiate that as part of the contract amendment.

- Sampling approach: for SIG/CAIQ we typically provide full control narratives + sampled attachments (per auditor request). For log sampling, we propose a stratified sample: 1 contiguous 7-day window for application logs and 30 random access-review entries across the target period. If AssuranceCo requires a 90-day contiguous log export, we'll need to schedule an extended extraction window.

I've attached the current evidence playbook for your review — it includes our standard sample sizes and dry-run checklist.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_playbook_v0.3.pdf
